result.instructions: Tools for Quaderno, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Quaderno data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run quaderno_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run quaderno_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run quaderno_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. quaderno_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ping
tools.title: Ping (verify auth)
tools.description: Verify the API key and connection by pinging Quaderno. Returns account/authentication status. Quaderno API: GET /ping.

tools.name: calculate_tax
tools.title: Calculate tax rate
tools.description: Calculate the correct tax rate/amount for a sale given the customer's location and product. This is Quaderno's flagship endpoint — it applies the right VAT / GST / US sales-tax rules per jurisdiction. READ-ONLY (no record is created). Quaderno API: GET /tax_rates/calculate. Returns { name, rate, country, region, county, city, tax_code, status (taxable|non_taxable|not_registered|reverse_charge), tax_amount, subtotal, total_amount }.

to_country.description: The customer's country — 2-letter ISO code (e.g. "US", "DE"). Required.

to_postal_code.description: The customer's ZIP / postal code (recommended for US sales tax).

to_city.description: The customer's city (recommended for US sales tax).

to_street.description: The customer's street address (recommended for US sales tax).

from_country.description: The seller's country (2-letter ISO); defaults to the account country.

tax_id.description: The customer's tax ID / VAT number (may trigger reverse-charge).

tax_behavior.description: Whether the amount includes tax or not.

product_type.description: Whether the product is a good or a service.

amount.description: Transaction amount to compute the tax on.

tools.name: quaderno_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Quaderno API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Path is taken after /api (e.g. "/tax_ids", "/evidence"). Quaderno API: GET {path}.

path.description: API path after /api, starting with a slash, e.g. "/tax_ids".

tools.name: create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: MUTATES Quaderno data — create a contact (customer or vendor). Provide kind plus a name; use `fields` for any other Quaderno contact attribute (phone_1, region, postal_code, city, street_line_1/2, tax_status, language, discount, notes, processor/processor_id). Quaderno API: POST /contacts. Returns the created contact.

first_name.description: For a person: their first name. For a company: the company name (Quaderno stores it here).

contact_name.description: The contact person's name at a company (companies only).

tax_id.description: The contact's tax ID / VAT number.

fields.description: Additional raw Quaderno fields merged into the request body (escape hatch for any field not typed above).

tools.name: update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: MUTATES Quaderno data — update an existing contact. Only the fields you pass are changed; use `fields` for any attribute not typed here. Quaderno API: PUT /contacts/{id}. Returns the updated contact.

fields.description: Additional raw Quaderno fields merged into the request body (escape hatch for any field not typed above).

tools.name: create_item
tools.title: Create a product (item)
tools.description: MUTATES Quaderno data — create a product/item in the catalog. Provide name + unit_cost; use `fields` for any other attribute (code, description, tax_class, tax_type, currency, country, stock). Quaderno API: POST /items. Returns the created item.

kind.description: Whether it is a one-off or a subscription product.

product_type.description: Whether the product is a good or a service.

fields.description: Additional raw Quaderno fields merged into the request body (escape hatch for any field not typed above).

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.description: MUTATES Quaderno data — create an invoice for a contact. Provide contact_id (or a contact via `fields`) and items; use `fields` for any other attribute (currency, issue_date, due_date, po_number, notes, tag_list, custom_metadata, payment_details). Each item = { description, quantity, unit_price, tax_1_name?, tax_1_rate?, discount_rate?, … }. Quaderno API: POST /invoices. Returns the created invoice (incl. permalink, pdf).

contact_id.description: The id of an existing contact to invoice. Omit only if you pass a full `contact` object via `fields`.

items.description: Line items, e.g. [{ description, quantity, unit_price, tax_1_name, tax_1_rate }].

fields.description: Additional raw Quaderno fields merged into the request body (escape hatch for any field not typed above).

tools.name: create_transaction
tools.title: Create a transaction
tools.description: MUTATES Quaderno data — record a sale or refund transaction (Quaderno computes tax and produces the compliant document). Provide the customer, items, and payment. Use `fields` for any other attribute (date, currency, shipping_address, evidence, processor, processor_id, processor_fee_cents, exchange_rate, po_number, notes, tags, custom_metadata). Quaderno API: POST /transactions. Returns the created invoice/credit-note object.

customer.description: The customer contact object (or reference), e.g. { first_name, last_name, email, country, tax_id }.

items.description: Required. Transaction line items, e.g. [{ description, amount, quantity, tax_code, product_type }].

payment.description: Payment object, e.g. { payment_method, amount, date }.

fields.description: Additional raw Quaderno fields merged into the request body (escape hatch for any field not typed above).
